uploaded_cases.canonical_trial_name: Kim et al. 2020 phase II hypofractionated proton beam therapy for HCC
uploaded_cases.setting: Definitive/curative; selected primary or recurrent/residual HCC
uploaded_cases.population: 45 patients; target lesion(s) ≤7 cm, ≤2 lesions, ≥2 cm from GI organs; Child–Pugh ≤7; ECOG 0–1; no extrahepatic metastases
